d: Brazil's 2026 presidential election has delivered a dramatic result. Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva has defeated Flavio Bolsonaro, son of former president Jair Bolsonaro and an ally of Donald Trump, to secure a historic fourth presidential term. But the narrow victory exposes a deeply divided country, with voters split over crime, the cost of living and Brazil's future. Lula has also sent a pointed message to Washington, declaring that Brazil is 'no one's backyard'. Meanwhile, Flávio Bolsonaro is challenging the result.
